title: More Than Half of Fortune 500 Now Spend at Least $100,000 a Year on Anthropic AI
summary:
The company's draft registration statement shows that its top enterprise customers spent a small portion of their overall operating budgets on AI services during the quarter ending September 2026. Revenue from Fortune 500 clients who pay at least $100,000 annually averaged less than 0.1% of those companies' total expenses, according to the S-1 filing, which also noted that over half of the Fortune 500 are currently in that payment bracket.

Anthropic has generated approximately $75B in revenue as it integrates its Claude AI into large-scale corporate workflows. The low proportion of overall expenses dedicated to AI suggests the company has substantial opportunity to increase spending and deepen adoption within its existing high-value client base.
